PROFILE SUMMARY
Strategic and detail oriented has 14 years of experience into Investment Banking, Capital market Fund Services (Mutual & Hedge funds), Client Onboarding, Reference Data Management, Functional UAT Testing within global financial institutions. raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE JP Morgan Chase & Co., Bangalore, Manager – Fund Accounting & Business Analyst Operations Key Deliverables:
07/2017 - 12/2025
Managed end-to-end NAV calculation for mutual funds & hedge funds ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with
client SLAs and regulatory standards.
Reviewed and validated complex financial instruments including equities, fixed income, TBA/MBS, derivatives (futures &
options), ETF and FX products for daily/monthly valuation.
Performed cash, position, and market value reconciliations, investigated breaks, and resolved discrepancies by liaising with
custodians, brokers, and internal teams.
Worked on fund accounting platforms such as WINS, invest one, system Implemented strong internal controls to ensure
accuracy.
Executed pricing validation using multiple vendor sources (Bloomberg, Reuters, IDC) and applied fair valuation techniques. Cleared exceptions generated through EMS Rules, ensuring validation with third-party sources and resolving asset breaks
such as maturity date check, duplicate trades, pricing of the securities.
Ensured all ETD transactions reconciled and matched with Broker statement and Position into Fund Accounting. Proactively
clearing the queries email from trade referral team and solving the stock and cash breaks in accounting systems.
Strong expertise in valuation oversight, price validation, and NAV control processes including tolerance checks, stale price
monitoring.benchmark checks.
Prepared NAV (Net Asset Value) calculations for hedge/ mutual funds on daily/monthly basis, ensuring accuracy of portfolio
valuation and investor allocations.
Managed multiple funds with complex structures (master-feeder, multi-currency, multi-asset). Timely following escalation matrix in case of issues, connecting via zoom calls with internal teams Reconciliation, COAC,
pricing, NAV, OSD and respective stakeholders. Implemented backup strategies and facilitated testing/migration of new clients using IRECS/Accord and Xceptor, addressing VET/CSW queries, COBALT breaks, and blotter mapping in IRECS.
Onboarding new secuirties setup with help of term sheet, BBG & IDC and client documents.
Identification of manual touchpoints and automation opportunities to reduce operational risk.
Root cause analysis, STP enablement, and process streamlining initiatives. Collaborated with cross-functional teams (Operations, Middle Office, Stakeholder ) in order to perform accurate NAV.
Project Handled as a Business Aanlyst
Fund Services UAT Testing (Instructions Capture):
Requirement gathering, BRD/FRD creation, JIRA and functional analysis for fund services platforms Extensive Functional & UAT testing experience across instruction capture, financial reporting, and accounting systems Defect management, test case creation (SWIFT, accounting flows), and sign-off coordination. Successfully onboarded the NYILM Project and identified critical defects across instruction capture applications. Created 200+ SWIFT test cases and proactively resolved issues with IC Operations leads and the VET team. Harvested SWIFT messages according to client requirements for smooth trade flow in the Fund accounting platform Product types of FI, Equity, ETD future and option, TBA and MBS.
Liaised with stakeholders to resolve sub-advisor requirements for suitable formats. Reviewed all swift trades once they were STP in WINS (Accounting platform).
Data Ǫuality Management and Data Governace :
Facilitated and supported Regulatory Reporting and Data Ǫuality initiatives across Financial Markets and Coverage
business lines, ensuring accurate and timely submissions of reports to global regulators.
Performed detailed business analysis and gap assessments to identify compliance breaches, data quality issues, and
control deficiencies across trade, position, and reference data domains.
Leveraged in-depth knowledge of the End-to-End Trade Lifecycle (Front-to-Back) including trade capture, confirmation,
clearing, settlement, and reporting to ensure regulatory alignment.
Led metadata management initiatives, documenting data lineage, data dictionaries, control frameworks, and data
ownership models to enhance transparency and audit readiness. Initiated a data quality management operating model to streamline firmwide regulatory reporting and analysis in AXIOM/CAPRI.
Discussed upstream complex feed and production issues with stakeholders and collaborated with cross-functional teams.
Interacted with technology partners to address data quality issues registered in the DǪM portal.
Operational changes requirement & business requirement document were shared to strategy team to understand the root
cause & create a JIRA, Summit, and DǪM accordingly for resolution.
Prepared senior management decks and regulatory governance updates summarizing data quality metrics, risk exposure,
remediation progress, and compliance posture.
Artemis Decommission (IRECS)
The system should automatically reconcile transaction records between source and target systems and flag mismatches. Performed gap analysis between legacy systems and target platforms, identifying improvement opportunities. Onboarded IRECS reconciliation for OTC Valuation, OTC Position, and OTC Cash& replicated the same logic and
calculations using
BRD, Tech Dump, and Artemis application for multiple clients. Focused on comparing the output to Artemis recs and analysing discrepancy, highlighting key issues prior to operational
Go live Identified and investigated issues (ARTEMIS between IRECS) and highlighted necessary changes to product development owners.
Liaised with Stakeholders and technology teams for project-related queries and requirement changes. Prepared Test Scenarios and Test Cases aligned with business flows & Supported UAT planning and execution with
business user.
State Street HCL Services Ltd., Coimbatore, Specialist – Client Onboarding & Reference Data Management |
09/2015 – 05/2017
Key Deliverables:
Led end-to-end client onboarding lifecycle, including KYC/AML checks, documentation validation, and account setup,
ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.
Streamlined onboarding workflows by identifying process gaps and implementing automation and standardization
initiatives, improving efficiency
Managed DTC & LATAM settlements and Reference Data Management team consisting of 14 members. Streamlined onboarding and account setup processes across multiple stages using Omgeo ALERT, Global Reference Data
system, and Global Trade management, enhancing workflow efficiency.
New account setup in GRS (Fund to custodian, Destination Records included SWIFT & FAX MT54X, MT304, MT2XX
messaging) which helps the custody receive SWIFT message for trade confirmation.
Ensured timely settlement by Setting up the Party Portfolio ID to Trade Processing Group Mapping, Custodian Data
seeding table, ETC Auto Affirm Portfolio, GTM Agent Bank ID Affirm in GTM Tools.
Ensured all procedures are followed when received the Custodian change & Scheduled changes request in relevant
systems for smooth trade settlement.
Ensured all Market opening tasks are activated in ALERT (Securities Equity & Fixed Income SSIs, FX, OTC SSIs). Ensured all Dead Accounts are removed from ALERT, GRS and GTM. Ensured sufficient coverage from AUS to NY market
time zones.
Coordinated daily with brokers, custodians, trade support, middle office, account transition, reconciliation, and PMG teams to manage corporate actions, overdrafts, claims, dividends, and physical settlements, ensuring effective communication.
Reviewed, investigated, and analysed alerts generated by surveillance systems, handling escalations and feedback routing.
Tata Consultancy Services, Bangalore, Senior Analyst – Client Onboarding & Reference data (Deutsche Bank)
01/2013 – 08/2015
Key Deliverables:
Facilitated account openings for various counterparties, including UBS, Goldman Sachs, and Blackrock, within the LSE. Handled client queries, provided break-fix solutions, performed root cause analysis, and validated settlement instructions
via SWIFT portals to ensure accurate transaction processing.
Handled account opening, maintenance, and tasks for Deutsche Bank (London & US region). Multiple asset class setup of cash and securities for basic and exchange data as per the client needs. Sources emails and
dB CAR.
Source settlement instructions from alert, company websites and liaise with Middle Office and client for the counter
party's settlement instructions.
Provided data access to internal clients via applications including eSpear, EDI, Global One, Fidessa with update SSI, and DB
Trader.
Handling Pre and post equity settlement accounts of the clients Account and Carry out Internal Audits within teams. Prepared MIS reports based on client requirements, calculating team and individual performance for management. Presented decks which includes capturing the volumes daily, error reports and root cause analysis.
JP Morgan Chase, Bangalore, Team Member – Fund Accounting
01/2012 – 11/2012
Key Deliverables:
Delivered fund services, reconciling trades between recap and WINS to ensure accurate financial reporting. Maintained accounting records, reviewed advisor information, custody records, and broker statements. Analysed financial records for errors and discrepancies, coordinating with the Boston team to resolve issues. Reviewed daily exception reports, researched trade validity, and ensured all trades were accounted for NAV calculation.
Responsible for researching the validity of trades with sources like Bloomberg.
Run the purchase & sale report to check whether all trades are match with the recap.
